subject: English
question_text: Write a dialogue between you and your father about the
guide_solution: Dialogue writing A dialogue between myself and my father about the profession I choose : Father : My dear son. How are you? Myself : I am okay, papa. How is your health? Father : I'm all right, but anxious about your future career. Myself : Why father, what is ailing you? Father : You're going to appear at the HSC exams shortly. Myself : I hope, I'll make a good result in the exams. Father : Where do you like to take your admission? Myself : Papa, I want to study at BUET on Telecommunications Engineering. Father : Why do you not like to study medical science? Myself : Papa, you know that I am weak in biology. Besides, it is a very horrible profession. Father : But it's very tough to get admission into BUET. Myself : I know, papa. There is a stiff competition in the admission test. Father : You need to study hard. Myself : Sure, papa. Some of my friends have agreed to study together. Father : Okay, dear. My prayers are always with you. Myself : Thank you, papa. → (iii) active; (e) → (ii) we should give up unpunctuality; (f) → (iii) He puts off things; (g) → (iii) the passage puts emphasis on punctuality.
